title: Oscars: Germany Selects Sandra Wollner’s ‘Everytime’ for International Feature Race
content: Sandra Wollner’s “Everytime” has been selected as Germany’s entry for the Academy Award for best international feature film. Due to a change in the rules of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences this spring, two major German films are already eligible for submission in the international feature film category: Visar Morina’s “Shame and […]
